warning: Wyoming closes parts of ten waterfowl areas to migratory bird hunting by hand-written legal descriptions in Chapter 14, Section 3 (Hawk Springs, Springer, Miller Lake, North Platte at Highway 157, Festo Lake, Wheatland No. 1, Ocean Lake, Eden Reservoir, Palisades Reservoir, South Park WHMA): none is drawn here. Read the description in Regs → Rules before hunting those waters. Not being listed does NOT make a place open.
source: WGFD Chapter 14 (Final April 2026), Section 3 Description of Closed Areas.
